name: FUN_QRTZ_TRIGGERS
description: This table stores information about configured triggers.

columns.name: SCHED_NAME
columns.description: Name for the given quartz schedule.

columns.name: TRIGGER_NAME
columns.description: Functional name of the quartz trigger.

columns.name: TRIGGER_GROUP
columns.description: Group associated with quartz trigger.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: Functional name of the quartz job.

columns.name: JOB_GROUP
columns.description: Group associated with quartz job.

columns.name: IS_VOLATILE
columns.description: Denotes persistence of jobs between program shutdown.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Stores detailed description associated with the trigger.

columns.name: NEXT_FIRE_TIME
columns.description: Next execution time of the trigger.

columns.name: PREV_FIRE_TIME
columns.description: Previous execution time of the trigger.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority associated with a job trigger.

columns.name: TRIGGER_STATE
columns.description: Stores the state of the trigger.

columns.name: TRIGGER_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the trigger (Simple, Cron, Blob)

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: First execution time of the trigger.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Last execution time of the trigger.

columns.name: CALENDAR_NAME
columns.description: Holds calendar details associated with trigger if any.

columns.name: MISFIRE_INSTR
columns.description: Holds the misfire instruction details of a trigger.

columns.name: JOB_DATA
columns.description: Parameters associated to a quartz job.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
